preconditions.description: The length of the string S is between 1 and 100,000.
The number of queries Q is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= L1 <= R1 <= len(S) for L1, R1, _, _ in queries)
preconditions.description: For each query, L1 and R1 are valid indices for the string S.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= L2 <= R2 <= len(S) for _, _, L2, R2 in queries)
preconditions.description: For each query, L2 and R2 are valid indices for the string S.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == ('Yes' if S[L1-1:R1] == S[L2-1:R2] else 'No') for i, (L1, R1, L2, R2) in enumerate(queries))
postconditions.description: For each query, the output is 'Yes' if the substrings S[L1-1:R1] and S[L2-1:R2] are equal, otherwise 'No'.
